scope: Sargent and Stachurski, Dynamic Programming, Volume 2 (General States), Chapter 1: Prelude: Examples of Dynamic Programs. Bounded measurable functions, contractions for the supremum distance and Banach's theorem on bX, Markov operators and the Neumann series; contracting dynamic programs with optimality, VFI, OPI and HPI; the firm valuation and sale problem (Theorem 1.1.1); entropic certainty equivalents, value-at-risk, recursive risk adjustment (1.14) and the failure of monotonicity for mean-variance; finite MDPs (Theorems 1.2.1-1.2.2, Lemma 1.2.3, Proposition 1.2.4) and cash management; continuous-time MDPs by uniformization and service rate control; optimal savings (Lemma 1.3.1, the Bellman operator, optimality given greedy policies) and the CRRA closed form; sequential analysis (Bayes updating and the Bellman operator); with the provable exercises.
source: Thomas J. Sargent and John Stachurski, Dynamic Programming, Volume 2: General States, Chapter 1, pp. 1-56, with the Appendix A results used there.
